name: Semaphore
security_staff_note: Guarded estimate by the list maintainer (@whatsdd) and not published by the company: the headcount this entity filed with Enhetsregisteret, which is a security-only business, so the whole payroll is security work. delivery_note: Delivery model recorded from the company's own description of how it staffs the work.

notes: Registry entity SEMAPHORE CONSULTING PARTNERS AS, Stabekk, whose former name was SCIO AS. A separate SEMAPHORE AS (org.nr 924505214, Oslo) also exists. Which one delivers the security testing in the list should be confirmed.
